result.reason: The operative language does not reach either playbook position. Although the grant names Affiliates and contractors, clauses (c) and (e) still prohibit outsourcing and access by anyone other than Licensee employees, effectively negating that extension; the margin comment does not cure this conflict. The clause also fails to make paid-up licences perpetual and irrevocable and does not permit transfer to a successor, including in an M&A transaction. Its termination language applies uniformly rather than distinguishing paid-up from subscription licences. The edits are limited and preserve the Field of Use and other commercial restrictions, but the unresolved contradictions materially impair drafting quality.
